videos.title: Our Foundation Strength Program for Armwrestling Explained
videos.summary:
Chetna is my coach when it comes to strength. For my first 10 years in armwrestling I did nothing but armwrestling-specific training and no foundational strength. Here she lays out the exact program we both follow.

In this one we cover:
- Why Chetna trains her whole body, not just hand and wrist
- The percentage routine: 60% for 9 reps, 70% for 7, 80% for 5, 90% for 3, then 105%
- How many sets to do as a beginner and as a national-level puller
- Using percentages on your accessories when a sore back is dragging your PRs down
- Our four-day gym week, day by day, and where table practice fits
- Why I went from training 7 days a week to 4 in the gym, and progress came quicker
- Leaning on your elbow every day, and why muscle strength isn't joint strength
